inputs.prompt:
Stylized realistic 3D game-cinematic look in the spirit of a modern Final Fantasy VII Remake cutscene: high-end real-time render quality, warm amber practical lighting, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain, natural fluid motion, consistent character designs across every shot.

Characters:
Tifa Lockhart: a young woman with very long straight black hair reaching her waist, dark red-brown eyes, a white sleeveless cropped tank top, a short black skirt with black suspenders, red fingerless leather gloves, calm and graceful.
Aerith Gainsborough: a young woman with long chestnut-brown hair in a thick braid tied with a big pink ribbon bow, loose bangs framing her face, bright green eyes, a long pink button-front dress, a short cropped red bolero jacket, brown boots, warm and playful.

Location: Seventh Heaven, a cozy wooden bar in the slums at night. A long polished dark-wood bar counter, shelves of glowing liquor bottles behind it, warm amber pendant lamps, an old jukebox in the corner, a wooden front door with a small brass bell. Tifa sits alone on a bar stool at the counter.

Storyboard (three shots, clean hard cuts):
[0s-2.5s] Shot 1: extreme close-up on the bar counter. Only Tifa's hand in a red fingerless glove is visible, slowly swirling a short glass of amber whiskey with a large ice cube; the ice turns and clinks, liquid catching the lamp light. No face in frame. Static camera, very shallow focus.
[2.5s-5s] Shot 2: low camera at knee height, framing only legs and the floor. The wooden front door swings open, the brass bell rings, and Aerith steps in: only the hem of her long pink dress and her brown boots are visible, walking across the worn wooden floorboards toward the bar. Nothing above the knees in frame. Camera static at floor level.
[5s-10s] Shot 3: over-the-shoulder shot from directly behind Aerith, her braid and pink ribbon in the foreground, walking slowly toward the bar. The camera follows behind her and gently arcs to the side until Tifa's face is revealed at the counter: Tifa turns on her stool, looks up at Aerith and her face brightens into a soft smile. Slow, smooth tracking move, end on Tifa's face in clear focus over Aerith's shoulder.

Camera: each shot its own angle, clean cuts, no dissolves, slow deliberate movement.

Audio: soft mellow jazz from an old jukebox, ice clinking in the glass, the brass door bell and a wooden door creak, light boot footsteps on wooden floorboards, quiet bar room tone. No dialogue.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks of any kind, no extra characters, no distorted hands or faces, keep both characters consistent with their descriptions.
